name: Mesa
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Mesa for 2026, and here is what he found: 26 family events, 15 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Merry Main Street Kick-off and Christmas Tree Lighting) through January 9 (Winter Wonderland Ice Rink), with the Mesa Santa Express light rail ride (December 11 to 13), Vertuccio Farms Christmas Fest (December 4 to 23) and Cirque Musica Holiday Wonderland (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Mesa

  • 26 Christmas events for kids in Mesa
  • 15 free events, including the Merry Main Street kick-off, Mesa Temple Lights, the Mesa Santa Express and free photos with Santa
  • Meet Santa: free visits at The Post during Merry Main Street, Sensory Santa (December 5), Breakfast with Santa and Cookies and Cocoa with Santa
  • Parades and tree lightings: Merry Main Street Kick-off and Christmas Tree Lighting (November 27)
  • Trains: Mesa Santa Express, a free ride on a decorated Valley Metro light rail car (December 11 to 13)
  • Season: November 27 to January 9

Planning a bigger day out? Mesa families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Phoenix, which covers ZooLights at the Phoenix Zoo, Las Noches de las Luminarias at the Desert Botanical Garden and the APS Electric Light Parade.
